host.title: Freebox host
host.description: Hostname or IP of the Freebox (default mafreebox.freebox.fr).

useHttps.title: Use HTTPS
useHttps.description: Use HTTPS instead of HTTP to reach the Freebox API (self-signed certificate accepted).

appId.title: App ID
appId.description: Application identifier registered against the Freebox.

appName.title: App name
appName.description: Application name shown on the Freebox front panel during authorization.

deviceName.title: Device name
deviceName.description: Device name shown on the Freebox front panel.

appToken.title: App token
appToken.description: Persisted Freebox application token. Leave empty to trigger the authorization flow (physical validation on the Freebox required). Filled automatically once granted.

powerProbePort.title: Power probe TCP port
powerProbePort.description: TCP port probed to detect Player power state (7000 = AirPlay, alternative 54243).

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll player/server status (minimum 5 seconds).

enableServer.title: Expose Freebox Server
enableServer.description: Expose the Freebox Server (CPU temperature, WAN connection state, optional reboot).

allowReboot.title: Allow reboot
allowReboot.description: DANGEROUS: expose a switch that reboots the Freebox Server.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed. If the list is empty, no devices will be excluded.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging purposes.
